login.title: Log in
login.subtitle: Welcome back! Enter your email and password.
login.promise: Your important people, memories, and plans stay in your private space.

register.title: Create an account
register.subtitle: Create a private space where Happy helps you remember what matters.
register.promise: Happy only keeps what you consciously add. The short introduction after registration is voluntary.
register.confirmationEmail: Check your email to confirm your registration. After confirmation, you will return to the application.

reset.title: Reset password
reset.subtitle: Enter your email. We will send you a link to set a new password.
reset.promise: We will never ask for your old password. The secure link is only used to restore access.
reset.success: ✅ Check your email — we sent you a link to set a new password.

updatePassword.title: Set a new password
updatePassword.subtitle: Enter a new password for your account.
updatePassword.promise: Your new password protects your private space. HappyDate never displays or stores it as readable text.
updatePassword.success: ✅ Your password was changed successfully. Log in again.
updatePassword.noSession: There is no active reset session. Open the link from the email again.

validation.passwordTooShort: Password must contain at least 6 characters.

errors.emailAlreadyRegistered: An account with this email already exists. Log in.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again shortly.
errors.network: Could not connect. Check your internet connection and try again.
errors.unauthorized: You need to log in again for this operation.
errors.expiredLink: This link is invalid or has expired.
